hook_text: There is NO force pushing a moving box forward. Your teacher wasn't lying.
clip_script: Four forces, each with a responsible object: Earth, floor, rope, rough surface. No force of motion, no force of speed — motion is not a force, and adding one is the oldest error in mechanics. A force is a push or a pull — an interaction between two objects. Every real force on your diagram must have another object responsible for it. If you cannot name the object doing the pushing or pulling, the force does not exist.
visual_style: A box sliding across the screen while ghost arrows labelled 'force of motion' get stamped DENIED, and the four real arrows snap onto a clean dot one by one.
pacing: Bold hook, rapid-fire arrow reveals, mic-drop rule at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw the 30-degree rope problem yourself.
